summary: The section headings were updated to blue text, which appears to be an intended design update. However, the contact text in the footer was changed to dark blue against a blue background, rendering it almost unreadable.

regressions.explanation: The text color of 'Contact us at: info@educationalinstitute.com' changed to dark blue on a blue background, causing severe contrast issues and making the text difficult to read.
regressions.violated_rule: Text color on colored backgrounds must maintain sufficient contrast for readability.
